# Narration drop folder

The interactive demo currently runs as a complete 150-second silent tour with timed bilingual captions.

When the author supplies narration, place the original file here without transcoding. The active filename will be recorded in `static/data/explainer-timeline.json` after its real duration and hash are checked. Sentence timings will then be aligned to the supplied recording; the current scene times are a pre-audio visual plan, not claimed audio timestamps.
